controls: Working-profile SQLite reads are WAL-aware; immutable mode is reserved for the sealed fixture.
A WAL-only mutation sensitivity test proves the working oracle rejects state an immutable read would miss.
The helper requires independent hashes for executable, provenance, app inventory, and source snapshot plus the exact unique compiled identifier.
The complete app bundle inventory, ad-hoc signature, arm64 architecture, executable path and hash are rechecked before launch and after exit.
HOME is never replaced and must match the current macOS account directory. All specified Dakia test/profile overrides are removed from the inherited launch environment.
The candidate has a 600-second handoff limit. Failure, signal, timeout, stale evidence, or integrity mismatch cannot seal and triggers exact-child termination followed by owned-profile quarantine.

Cleanup remains available when candidate or provenance integrity fails, but still requires exact UUID, bundle identifier, immediate Application Support child, control-marker identity, stopped process, and zero open handles.
The original sealed fixture is revalidated in full at final sealing and never moved or modified.
remainingRisk: The runtime Internet-socket inventory is point-in-time evidence and cannot by itself exclude a connection that completed before capture. The fixture also has zero credentials, an account confined to loopback port 9, and a candidate overlay with no updater endpoints.
The CUA observation record is parent-supplied. Final acceptance requires the parent to retain the actual exact-PID, exact-executable, tauri://localhost/ accessibility or screenshot evidence.
The helper is intentionally limited to private ad-hoc fixture acceptance and provides no public release assurance.
